Software supports documentation; the employer retains responsibility for occupational safety. Consulting and software services should be distinguished from individual module commitments.

summary.en: raumAKUSTIKS designs and delivers business acoustics and noise-control solutions. Reverberation reduction and machine noise control address different problems. Buyers should assess sources, transmission paths, fire requirements, installation and target measurements. Absorbers do not replace structural isolation of vibration; measures must be planned for the specific room.
